_comment: Frontend Agent Team defaults. A project may override any top-level key in <project>/.claude/frontend.json. Model tier names live in ~/.claude/backend/config.json; roles below map this team one by one.

fe-designer.down_to_sonnet_when: carrying out a decided change: wording, sync, fill-in

fe-engineer.up_to_opus_when: cross-stack row, template data layer, or a written invariant is touched

fe-tester.up_to_opus_when: writing a new assertion that must be shown to fail

model_tiering_rule: Judgement -> opus; carrying out a decided conclusion -> sonnet. Say which and why at each dispatch.

gates._comment: Human stops. Plan (and Acceptance in implement) are fixed; everything else stops only for a PLAYBOOK §3F case.

frontend_backend_boundary: Declared by the project, with who ruled it and a date, in <project>/.claude/project-context.md. The harness presets nothing; an unwritten line stops the queue.
